<table class="rf-crosswalk">
  <thead>
    <tr>
      <th>UMRR HANDBOOK TERM(S)</th>

    </tr>
  </thead>

  <tbody>
    <tr class="group">
      <td colspan="3">DREDGING AND CHANNEL RESTORATION</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Backwater dredging;<br>backwater dredge cut;<br>secondary-channel dredge cut;<br>environmental dredging</td>
      <td class="database"><code>DredgingEvent</code></td>
      <td>Dredging;<br>dredging for fish habitat;<br>dredging for access;<br>dredge cut</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Secondary-channel cut;<br>channel restoration;<br>restored secondary channel</td>
      <td class="database"><code>FlowChannel</code></td>
      <td>Dredge cut;<br>dredging for fish habitat</td>
    </tr>

    <tr class="group">
      <td colspan="3">SHORELINE, RIVER-TRAINING, AND FISH FEATURES</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Shoreline and riverbank protection;<br>rock revetment;<br>off-bankline revetment;<br>root-wad revetment</td>
      <td class="database"><code>Revetment</code></td>
      <td>Shoreline stabilization;<br>rock revetment;<br>offshore rock mound</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Closure structure;<br>rock closure;<br>wing dam;<br>closing dam;<br>dike;<br>weir;<br>chevron;<br>vane;<br>rock sill;<br>flow-diversion structure</td>
      <td class="database"><code>RiverineFlowStructure</code></td>
      <td>River-training structure;<br>closure structure;<br>chevron;<br>bullnose;<br>guide structure;<br>flow-diversion structure</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Closure alignment;<br>dike alignment;<br>wing-dam alignment;<br>chevron alignment;<br>vane alignment</td>
      <td class="database"><code>RiverineFlowStructureLine</code></td>
      <td>River-training-structure alignment;<br>closure-structure alignment</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Wing-dam notch;<br>notched closure structure;<br>low-flow notch</td>
      <td class="database"><code>Notch</code></td>
      <td>Notched structure;<br>RTS-notching</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Fish LUNKER;<br>boulder cluster;<br>woody debris;<br>wood-pile structure</td>
      <td class="database"><code>FishStructure</code></td>
      <td>Woody bundle;<br>anchored or locked log</td>
    </tr>

    <tr class="group">
      <td colspan="3">FLOODPLAIN, WETLAND, AND VEGETATION FEATURES</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Depressional wetland;<br>emergent wetland;<br>restored wetland;<br>wetland habitat</td>
      <td class="database"><code>Wetland</code></td>
      <td>Potholes and depressional wetlands;<br>emergent wetland;<br>topo-wetlands;<br>island with emergent wetland</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Reforestation;<br>wetland-species planting;<br>floodplain forest planting;<br>grass, sedge, rush, and forb planting</td>
      <td class="database"><code>FloraPlantingOrSeeding</code></td>
      <td>Tree planting;<br>vegetation</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Exterior berm;<br>interior berm;<br>water-management embankment</td>
      <td class="database"><code>Embankment</code></td>
      <td>Topo-berm;<br>island with berm</td>

    <tr>
      <td>Berm or embankment alignment</td>
      <td class="database"><code>EmbankmentCenterline</code></td>
      <td>Berm alignment</td>
    </tr>

    <tr class="group">
      <td colspan="3">ISLAND FEATURES</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Island creation;<br>barrier island;<br>seed island;<br>log-rock structure;<br>mud flat;<br>sand flat;<br>turtle nesting mound;<br>delta formation</td>

      <td>Island;<br>narrow island;<br>wide island;<br>rock-ring island;<br>island with berm;<br>island with emergent wetland;<br>seed island</td>

    <tr>
      <td>Island alignment;<br>barrier-island alignment;<br>shoreline-protection alignment</td>
      <td class="database"><code>IslandLine</code></td>

    </tr>

    <tr class="group">
      <td colspan="3">WATER-LEVEL-MANAGEMENT FEATURES</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Moist Soil Management Unit;<br>managed backwater lake;<br>water-level-management unit</td>
      <td class="database"><code>MoistSoilMgmtUnits</code></td>

    <tr>
      <td>Overflow spillway;<br>stoplog structure;<br>gated structure;<br>water-level-control structure</td>
      <td class="database"><code>WaterControlStructure</code></td>

    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Pump station;<br>water-level-management pump</td>
      <td class="database"><code>PumpStation</code></td>
      <td>Water-management infrastructure</td>
    </tr>

    <tr>
      <td>Water-management well;<br>water-supply well</td>
      <td class="database"><code>Well</code></td>
      <td>Water-management infrastructure</td>
    </tr>
  </tbody>
</table>

<table class="rf-crosswalk">

  <tbody>

    <tr>
